sources.title: Compliance automation market sizing
sources.snippet: Independent estimates put compliance automation at $2.6-3.0B for 2025 with growth of 20-24% annually. The startup segment between Series A and Series C in North America is a small fraction of that, plausibly $300-400M.

sources.title: Vanta and Drata category position
sources.snippet: Vanta and Drata are the two clear leaders in compliance automation, both heavily funded, and both have been extending down-market toward earlier-stage companies. Open-source alternatives exist for control monitoring but do not produce auditor-ready evidence packages.

sources.title: Retention benchmarks in compliance software
sources.snippet: Net revenue retention above 100% is typical for compliance vendors serving growing startups, as customers add frameworks over time. CAC payback of 12-18 months is within the normal band.
